summary: Trinity Biotech plc filed a Form 6-K on June 16, 2026, announcing significant purchase orders for over 2 million TrinScreen HIV tests and reporting Q1 2026 financial results. The orders reinforce demand in global health markets, supporting 2026 revenue and profitability targets. Q1 revenues increased 43% to $10.8m, with gross margin improving from 25.2% to 35.4%. Net loss narrowed to $4.4m from $8.8m year-over-year. The filing is a routine operational and financial update, not a special situation.
